description: This file defines an abstract class 'ShapeRenderInfo' that provides rendering information for shape objects within the MigraDoc document rendering process. It includes properties to access the associated document shape.

classes.name: ShapeRenderInfo
classes.description: An abstract class that contains rendering information for shapes, extending RenderInfo, with a property to access the associated Shape object.

methods.name: DocumentObject (getter)
methods.description: Returns the shape associated with this rendering info, or throws if null.

methods.name: DocumentObject (setter)
methods.description: Sets the shape associated with this rendering info.
